Ben / Laura — quick technical readout and recommendation below. I pulled the workload sheet and ran a baseline mapping:

Summary mapping:
- Nominal profile: 32 concurrent workers => recommend Dedicated pool = 8x A100-40GB (or 12x A30-equivalent with mixed concurrency).
- Burst headroom: allow a soft autoscale + buffer equivalent to additional 2x A100 GPUs for 72-hour windows; this covers predicted spikes to 6M tokens/day with batching policy (max batch size 64, adaptive latency budget).
- Latency: with optimized kernel selection and KV/prefix caching we estimate P50=35-50ms, P99~110-140ms depending on prompt length distribution. We'll hit <120ms P99 on typical short prompt paths with the recommended config and aggressive KV caching.
- Cost delta for fallback (quantized 4-bit variant + increased batching): ~35% lower per-token cost, expected P99 ~200-300ms for the same concurrency. Good as a temporary fallback when nodes are constrained.

Constraints / blockers:
- Region affinity: Maestro wants us in us-west-2 (requested in MOU). Current reserved commitments have scheduled maintenance in week of 2026-11-15 in that region; that reduces available headroom for the proposed burst buffer.
- Thermal/roster conflicts: two upcoming enterprise rollouts have 'soft holds' overlapping in early Nov which may limit contiguous A100 capacity.

Suggested ops hold wording (for ops ticket):
"Request: provisional soft hold for Dedicated capacity to serve Maestro Labs (DEAL-2026-1729). Requested window 2026-10-20 to 2026-12-04. Allocation target: 8x A100-40GB (primary) + 2x A100-40GB (burst buffer), region us-west-2. Release triggers: (1) written cancellation from customer, (2) failure to sign SOW by 2026-12-04, or (3) emergency capacity reclaim with 7-day notice to customer. Fallback plan: auto-route to quantized-4bit model variant with batching profile X when burst resources exceed pool.
"
Action items assigned:
- Ops: please validate whether a 45-day soft hold can be set in us-west-2 given maintenance windows; if not, recommend alternative region with equivalent latency.
- Legal/Procurement: ensure hold wording is non-binding (soft hold) and reflected in SOW appendix.
- Sales (Ben): confirm start/end windows with Maestro and capture any flexibility.

I'll attach a quick node-mapping matrix (internal) if ops wants to see specific GPUs to earmark.

Rishi Malhotra
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
